about_the_game:
Build Your Business from Your Room

Step into the shoes of a young entrepreneur starting from scratch in your own room. Buy and sell products to earn money, deliver them on time, and expand your catalog with more profitable items. Keeping your customers satisfied is the key to growing your business!

How to Play

Check orders every day, carefully prepare your products, and ship them on time. Fun mini-games determine the quality of your packaging — the better you pack, the higher your store rating will climb. Poor packaging, on the other hand, can lead to bad reviews and unhappy customers.

When night comes, finish any remaining packages and make sure to pay your bills and rent. To grow your business and stay competitive, you’ll need to make smart choices and manage your time wisely.

Key Features

✔ Entrepreneur Experience – Start from a small room and build your own business by buying and selling products.
✔ Packaging Mini-Games – Play interactive mini-games to pack products securely and ensure customer satisfaction.
✔ Customer Reviews & Store Rating – Your packaging quality directly impacts your store’s reputation.
✔ Time Management Challenges – Work during the day, finish orders at night, and keep up with your bills.
✔ Competitive Market – Prove yourself against other businesses and claim your place in the industry.
✔ Progression & Growth – Unlock more profitable products and expand your operations step by step.

Are You Ready to Become the Best Store?

Every order is an opportunity, and every customer review shapes your future. Make the right decisions, outpace the competition, and prove yourself as the ultimate entrepreneur. Are you ready?

short_description: Packonomy is a fun business simulation set in the nostalgic 90s atmosphere, where you start your entrepreneurial journey right from your own room. Buy products, manage your inventory, gain advantages through mini-games, unlock new products, and grow your business by keeping your customers happy!
